purpose: Define DWH input governance at the data origin before local or remote processing, using the origin's declared input boundary independently from downstream output policy.

topics.name: DWH Origin Input Governance
topics.purpose: Define DWH input governance at the data origin before local or remote processing, using the origin's declared input boundary independently from downstream output policy.

semantics.origin_rule: Input governance is evaluated at the origin where data enters the governed DWH path.
semantics.scope_rule: Remote input scope is explicit and evaluated against the origin input classification/policy.
semantics.identity_rule: Where identity-scoped input is used, exact resolved identity context is required.
semantics.separation_rule: Input permission does not imply output permission.
semantics.ac_rule: When AccessCore is active, AccessCore authorization is evaluated in addition to DWH input-boundary policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Unclassified/unresolved governed input fails according to explicit policy rather than default expansion.
semantics.trace_rule: Accepted/rejected input retains origin, scope, identity and policy refs.

invariants.rule: DWH applies data-boundary policy at the origin and target independently; remote addressing, transport reachability and external registration never substitute for AccessCore authorization.

hard_gates.condition: identity-scoped input has no exact identity

references.purpose: AC authorization remains orthogonal to DWH boundary policy.

prose.summary: Define DWH input governance at the data origin before local or remote processing, using the origin's declared input boundary independently from downstream output policy.
